CHAPTER.VERS: Praise YAH! Blessed is the man who fears Jehovah, who delights greatly in His Commandments.
His seed shall be mighty on the earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth and riches will be in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.
Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness; he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
A good man deals graciously and lends; he will guide his affairs with justice.
Surely he shall never be shaken; the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; his heart is steadfast, trusting in Jehovah.
His heart is secure; he will not be afraid, though he sees his adversary.
He has dispersed abroad, he has given to the poor; his righteousness stands forever; his horn shall be exalted with honor.
The wicked shall see and be indignant; he shall gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.
